description: A classifier guard in an earlier stage cannot test a locally declared feature.

documents.p.md:

%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%classifier c
 f? "a" ∈ A
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes ∩ A ≠ ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
